## 7-Agent Dynamic Model Routing
Implements `ai-7-agent-dynamic-model-routing.md`: 7 roles (Leader, Planner, Architect, Developer/Executor, Tester, Reviewer, Researcher) with **per-task model routing**.

**Model Capability Registry** marks a model `available` only when its provider key exists in the n8n environment (`GROQ_API_KEY` / `OLLAMA_API_KEY` / `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, set in the .env file next to docker-compose.yml). Keys never appear in this JSON. Claude/GPT/DeepSeek are reachable only through OpenRouter and only when its key is set.

POST `/webhook/ai-team/start` with `{requirement, domain?, expected_outputs?, constraints?, documents?}`. Optional `agents` maps a role name to a MindFlow agent `{name, provider, model, system_prompt}` (sent by the MindFlow AI Factory page): the router honors that agent's provider/model and system prompt for the role when the provider is configured in the n8n env, and reports the assignment (or why it was ignored) in the final package. Tasks run sequentially in dependency order; the review gate allows at most 2 revision rounds. Run one execution at a time (run state uses workflow static data). The webhook is answered immediately (Respond Accepted); when the caller sends `callback_url` + `callback_token` (the MindFlow AI Factory page does), the final package is POSTed back to that URL at the end. A Telegram notification is sent on completion when TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID are set in the n8n env.
